import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353L;
    static final long MODD = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_N = 1000005;
    static final long INF = 1000000000000000000L;

    static long[] p10 = new long[15];
    static List<String>[] groups = new List[7];
    static List<Long>[] sorted_vals = new List[7][7];
    static long[] prefix = new long[7][7];

    static long to_int(String s) {
        long res = 0;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        return res;
    }

    static class Query implements Comparable<Query> {
        String prefix;
        int rem;

        Query(String prefix, int rem) {
            this.prefix = prefix;
            this.rem = rem;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Query other) {
            return this.prefix.compareTo(other.prefix);
        }
    }

    static class Result {
        long cnt;
        long res;

        Result(long cnt, long res) {
            this.cnt = cnt;
            this.res = res;
        }
    }

    static Result solve(String prefix, int rem, long cnt) {
        if (rem == -1) return new Result(cnt, 0);
        int L = rem / 2, R = rem - L;
        if (rem == 1) {
            L = 1;
            R = 0;
        }

        long res = ((cnt - to_int(prefix) % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
        cnt++;

        for (String left : groups[L]) {
            String comb = prefix + left;
            res = (res + ((-to_int(comb) % MOD + cnt + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
            cnt++;

            if (left.length() == L) {
                long val = to_int(comb) % MOD;
                for (int sz = 1; sz <= R; ++sz) {
                    long cst = ((-val * p10[sz] % MOD + cnt + MOD) % MOD);
                    List<Long> vec = sorted_vals[R][sz];
                    int pos = lowerBound(vec, (MOD - cst) % MOD);
                    res = (res + (long) vec.size() * cst % MOD + prefix[R][sz] - (long) MOD * (vec.size() - pos)) % MOD;
                }
                cnt += groups[R].size();
            }
        }
        return new Result(cnt, res);
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < key) {
                low = mid + 1;
            } else {
                high = mid;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            groups[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                sorted_vals[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        String s = String.valueOf(n);
        int N = s.length();

        p10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) {
            p10[i] = p10[i - 1] * 10;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
            String num = String.valueOf(i);
            String pad = num;
            while (pad.length() <= 6) {
                pad = "0" + pad;
                groups[pad.length()].add(pad);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 1; len <= 6; ++len) {
            for (String prev : groups[len - 1]) {
                groups[len].add(prev);
            }
            Collections.sort(groups[len]);

            for (int j = 0; j < groups[len].size(); ++j) {
                long val = (j - Integer.parseInt(groups[len].get(j)) + MOD) % MOD;
                sorted_vals[len][groups[len].get(j).length()].add(val);
            }

            for (int sz = 1; sz <= len; ++sz) {
                Collections.sort(sorted_vals[len][sz]);
                for (long v : sorted_vals[len][sz]) {
                    prefix[len][sz] = (prefix[len][sz] + v) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        List<Query> queries = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder cur = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            for (int d = 0; d <= 9; ++d) {
                if (d == s.charAt(i) - '0') continue;
                if (i == 0 && d == 0) continue;

                cur.append((char) ('0' + d));
                if (d <= s.charAt(i) - '0') {
                    queries.add(new Query(cur.toString(), s.length() - i - 1));
                } else {
                    queries.add(new Query(cur.toString(), s.length() - i - 2));
                }
                cur.deleteCharAt(cur.length() - 1);
            }
            cur.append(s.charAt(i));
            queries.add(new Query(cur.toString(), 0));
        }

        long cnt = 1;
        long ans = 0;
        Collections.sort(queries);

        for (Query q : queries) {
            if (s.charAt(q.prefix.length() - 1) == q.prefix.charAt(q.prefix.length() - 1)) {
                ans = (ans + ((-to_int(q.prefix) % MOD + cnt + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                cnt++;
                continue;
            }
            Result res = solve(q.prefix, q.rem, cnt);
            cnt = res.cnt;
            ans = (ans + res.res) % MOD;
        }

        ans = (ans % MODD + MODD) % MODD;
        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }
}
